chapter: Pittsburgh school days and old jealousies
title: Ben Webster, her first love
summary: Ben Webster came from a wealthy family and was too wild to marry; he calmed down after a year in the Kirk band.

story.theme_name: Band pranks, jokes and gigs gone wrong

blocks.x: Anything else you can tell us?

I guess plenty of things. I can't think of anything right now... Ben Webster in Kansas City, I met him. Did I tell you about him? He came from a very wealthy wonderful family of doctors and lawyers and teachers, but he lived right around the corner from 12th Street, a pretty rough street where all the night clubs were. They said when Ben Webster was 15 or 16 years old his parents were putting $75, $100, $50 suits on him then. He was called little Peck's Bad Boy because they couldn't keep him in college. He'd been sent to several colleges. One day Ben was telling

us a story. He said the girls were dressing in the dormitory and he was peeping through the window and fell through the window. He had a cut on his arm. But he was a terrific tenor man and Ben Webster was really my first love. We used to be together all the time. I loved him. Things that he did in the band would shame the boys and after he was with us about a year he was just as nice and calm, because the guys were so nice in the band and they always helped wild musicians like Ben and he was really a wild one.
But he was your first love and nothing ever came of it?
No, no, no. He was really a wild man and he was really too wild for me.
Do you want to stop and check your notes again?
